protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

 The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

uuid.description: Unique identifier for the interaction returned in the resource response; the response ID.

v1alpha1CollectionMetadata.title: Metadata that will be returned with each collection-level GET

content_id.description: Unique identifier for the entity; only required for GetContentResponse.

connector_id.description: Unique identifier of the connector; only required for GetContentResponse.

seed_source_location.description: Unique identifier used for content discovery; the Content Group source location for the collection domain.

display_source_location.description: User-facing source location if different from original source location.

is_folder.description: Indicates if content is a folder; a folder is not ingested, but recursively discovers other contents.

parent_id.description: Indicates if content is embedded in another content source: links related content items when previewing, for example, a record that has related attachments to be processed separately in different pipelines.

created_at.description: Date and time the content was originally created.

updated_at.description: Date and time the content was last updated.

description.description: Brief description, summary or abstract of the content.

comment.description: Comments or annotations associated with the content.

body.description: Body of the content for non-files, for example, articles or reports; maximum is 1MB.

path.description: File path or location within a file system.

size.description: Size of the file in bytes.

opaque_data.description: Hidden string with additional information the PULL API uses to retrieve the content data and source location from the underlying content; for example, drinve_id + item_id in SharePoint; only when the universal connector pushes content to the Pryon Ingestion Platform.

data.description: Base64 encoded data for files less than 4 MB; only when the universal connector pushes content to the Pryon Ingestion Platform.

created_by.description: Content creator or author in connected platform.

updated_by.description: Unique identifier for user who last updated the content in connected platform.

assigned_to.description: Unique identifier for user assigned a task or content.

custom_attributes.description: Custom attributes that are not part of the recommended set; used for fields that do not match another field in the content message type.

system_status_reason.description: Detailed reason for the system status.

v1alpha1ContentDataResponse.title:
The response contains the Content-Range header and the content data.
HTTP/1.1 206 Partial Content
Content-Range: bytes <range-start>-<range-end>/<total_size>
Content-Length: <bytes-length>
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

v1alpha1ContentStatus.description:
The Connector Content system status is only updated by the server.
Do not set on proxy integrations.

 - INITIATED: The content has been identified for processing but has not yet been processed.
Indicates that the content has been identified and is ready to start the uploading and downloading content data steps.
 - UPLOADING: Indicates that the content is currently being uploaded in parts. This status is useful if you want to track the progress of the upload before all parts are complete.
 - UPLOAD_COMPLETE: Indicates that all parts of the content have been successfully uploaded and the content is ready to be processed.
 - DOWNLOADING: Indicates that the content is currently being downloaded in parts. This status can be used if there's a need to track the progress of the download before all parts are complete.
 - DOWNLOAD_COMPLETE: Indicates that all parts of the content have been successfully downloaded and the content is ready to be processed.
 - PROCESSED: The content has been successfully processed and is ready for ETL and indexing steps.
 - FAILED: There was an error while processing this piece of content. The error could be due to various reasons, such as format issues or communication problems with the source.
 - DELETED: The content has been removed, either because it was deleted from the source and was detected and propagated during the synchronization process.

emails.description: List of emails and associated content permissions.

allow_emails.description: List of emails with read permission for the content.

allow_group_ids.description: List of group IDs with read permission for the content.

deny_emails.description: List of emails without read permission for the content.

deny_group_ids.description: List of group IDs without read permission for the content.

any_required_group_ids.description: User must belong to at least one of the listed groups in order to access the content; read permission can still be restricted for users of the group.

all_required_group_ids.description: User must belong to all of the listed groups in order to access the content; read permission can still be restricted for users of the group.

unrestricted_emails.description: List of emails that are always allowed read permission for the content.
